verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents an API reference, but the only visible sections are custom-integration push APIs (Integration Monitoring) and Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs. Nothing shows that UI workflows such as access reviews, AI-system governance, findings and tasks, or questionnaires can be done through the API, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Webhooks are inbound ingestion only, so they add nothing toward API parity. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage matching the UI, a published OpenAPI spec, write endpoints for core workflows, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
